purpose: Fix solve_cascade's dependency-spec rewrite-key construction (crates/callisto-graph/src/cascade.rs, RewriteKey.name at the site that currently reads `name: edge.to.name().to_string()`, inside the `if d.rewrite { ... }` block around line 269) so that, when the rewrite target is a dual-identity package registered in IdentityIndex under different native names per ecosystem (e.g. a Cargo crate that is also a napi-rs npm package), the key uses the name actually present in the dependent manifest being rewritten -- looked up via IdentityIndex::native_name(&edge.to, eco) where `eco` is the dependent's own already-computed ecosystem -- instead of PackageId::name(), which is the name registered for the dependency's OWN native ecosystem and can differ from what the cross-ecosystem dependent manifest actually wrote. The wrong key is currently passed to callisto-manifests's update_dependency_spec, which returns Err(ManifestError::DependencyNotFound) when the key does not match a real manifest entry, aborting apply_version_plan for the affected package. This spec threads an `&IdentityIndex` through CascadeInput and Workspace so solve_cascade has the data it needs, following the exact precedent set by Track 1's `tags: &TagIndex` threading (SPEC-TRACK1-FIXED-GROUP-CASCADE-CORRECTNESS): a new required field on CascadeInput, supplied at both real construction sites, sourced from a new field on Workspace populated once at Workspace::load time from the resolver's already-computed IdentityIndex.
scope: crates/callisto-graph/src/cascade.rs (CascadeInput struct, the single RewriteKey-construction site inside solve_cascade's `if d.rewrite` block), crates/callisto-graph/src/lib.rs (Workspace struct and Workspace::load), crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/version.rs (plan_version's CascadeInput construction, line 73), crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/snapshot.rs (plan_snapshot's CascadeInput construction, line 54), and every test-only CascadeInput struct-literal construction site in crates/callisto-graph/src/cascade.rs's own `#[cfg(test)]` module and crates/callisto-graph/tests/cascade_tests.rs (8 + 6 = 14 sites confirmed by direct grep count as of this spec). No change to IdentityIndex's internal structure, native_name's signature, callisto-manifests's update_dependency_spec, or cascade_action. Also touches every hand-constructed Workspace struct literal outside Workspace::load -- Workspace derives no Default and its literals use no `..` rest pattern, so all 18 confirmed sites across 6 test files stop compiling the moment Workspace.identity is added: crates/callisto-graph/tests/validate_command_tests.rs (lines 112, 180), crates/callisto-graph/tests/snapshot_tests.rs (lines 70, 132, 183, 255), crates/callisto-graph/tests/matrix_tests.rs (lines 63, 101), crates/callisto-graph/tests/graph_tests.rs (line 35), crates/callisto-graph/tests/tags_tests.rs (lines 62, 172, 333, 494), crates/callisto-graph/tests/publish_tests.rs (lines 167, 679, 742, 974, 1342). Each needs `identity: IdentityIndex::default()` added to its literal (none of these fixtures involve dual-identity packages, so the default/empty index is the correct fill value in every case).
non_goals: Track 1 (fixed-group cascade correctness, already shipped) and any change to the Fixed-group convergence block or GroupTable::resolve's conflict detection -- unrelated code paths in the same file, out of scope for this spec.
Track 2 (platform-manifest writes, already shipped) and any change to plan_version's platform_writes/optional_dep_updates producer logic -- unrelated.

cascade_action's peer-escalation severity fix -- a separate, narrower Track 9 sub-bug already fixed and committed independently in this same session as a lighter-loop change; this spec covers ONLY the rewrite-key bug.

Redesigning IdentityIndex's own internal structure, native_name's signature, or the Layer 1 (callisto-model) / Layer 2 (callisto-graph) boundary itself -- this spec threads existing, already-implemented identity data through to where it is needed; it does not change how identity resolution works or weaken the layer-isolation invariant (IdentityIndex remains a callisto-graph type; it is never exposed through the generic, callisto-model-defined DependencyResolver trait).

Any change to update_dependency_spec or other callisto-manifests write logic -- that crate already correctly errors on an unmatched key; this spec fixes what key gets constructed, not how a key is consumed.

Constructing or exposing an IdentityIndex for any DependencyResolver implementation other than ManifestWalkResolver. Workspace::load is defined only in the `impl<'a, R: CommandRunner> Workspace<'a, R, ManifestWalkResolver>` block (crates/callisto-graph/src/lib.rs), which is not generic over D, so `graph.identity()` -- a method defined on ManifestWalkResolver itself, not on the DependencyResolver trait -- is callable there without any trait-bound change. A test double implementing DependencyResolver with no identity() method is unaffected by this spec; such tests supply CascadeInput.identity directly as a struct-literal field, per AC-005.

Deduplicating or otherwise changing IdentityIndex.native's insertion/lookup semantics when the same (PackageId, Ecosystem) pair is registered more than once -- native_name's existing first-match iteration order (BTreeMap iteration, deterministic) is used as-is.

api_surface.name: CascadeInput.identity
api_surface.description: New required field added to CascadeInput (crates/callisto-graph/src/cascade.rs; currently 9 fields: graph, groups, cfg, seed, reasons, named_by, base, pre, tags -- none named identity). IdentityIndex is defined in crates/callisto-graph/src/identity.rs and already derives Clone. Required so the RewriteKey-construction site inside solve_cascade's `if d.rewrite { ... }` block can call `input.identity.native_name(&edge.to, eco)`. Both real construction sites must supply it via the new Workspace.identity field (see that api_surface entry): commands/version.rs's plan_version and commands/snapshot.rs's plan_snapshot both use `identity: &ws.identity`. Every test-only CascadeInput struct literal (8 sites in cascade.rs's test module, 6 sites in tests/cascade_tests.rs) must add an `identity: &IdentityIndex` field -- `&IdentityIndex::default()` for tests with no dual-identity fixture, or a populated IdentityIndex constructed via direct insertion into its public `native` field (crates/callisto-graph/src/identity.rs, e.g. `let mut idx = IdentityIndex::default(); idx.native.insert((Ecosystem::Cargo, "my-native-lib".to_string()), d_id.clone());`) for tests that need native_name to resolve -- this is the only construction mechanism in use anywhere in the codebase today (confirmed at identity.rs's own tests and ecosystem_bugs_test.rs); there is no dedicated builder/helper function.

api_surface.name: Workspace.identity
api_surface.description: New required field on Workspace<'a, R, D> (crates/callisto-graph/src/lib.rs), an owned IdentityIndex (it derives Clone, so no new lifetime bound is needed on Workspace). Populated ONLY inside the existing non-generic-over-D impl block (`impl<'a, R: CommandRunner> Workspace<'a, R, ManifestWalkResolver>`), the same place Workspace::load already computes `graph.identity()` today for GroupTable::resolve and promoted_siblings (crates/callisto-graph/src/lib.rs:109,116) -- e.g. `identity: graph.identity().clone()` added to Workspace::load's `Ok(Self { ... })` construction. This field, not a direct `ws.graph.identity()` call, is required at plan_version/plan_snapshot's CascadeInput construction sites: both functions are generic over `D: DependencyResolver` (plan_version<R, D, I>, plan_snapshot<R, D>), and ManifestWalkResolver::identity() is an inherent method, not part of the DependencyResolver trait bound (defined in callisto-model, Layer 1, which cannot reference IdentityIndex, a Layer 2 callisto-graph type, without violating this repo's CLAUDE.md layer-isolation invariant) -- so `ws.graph.identity()` does not compile inside either generic function body regardless of what D is instantiated with at any real call site. Only a plain struct-field read, `&ws.identity`, compiles unconditionally since it has no bound on D. The two real construction sites (version.rs, snapshot.rs) pass `identity: &ws.identity` as the CascadeInput.identity field.

api_surface.name: cascade::solve_cascade (RewriteKey.name construction, corrected)
api_surface.signature: Inside solve_cascade's existing `if d.rewrite { ... }` block (crates/callisto-graph/src/cascade.rs, `match rewrite_spec(...) { RewriteOutcome::Rewritten(to_spec) => { let key = RewriteKey { ... } ... } }`). solve_cascade's own public signature is unchanged: `pub fn solve_cascade<D: DependencyResolver>(input: CascadeInput<'_, D>) -> Result<CascadeOutcome, GraphError>`.
api_surface.description: Replace `name: edge.to.name().to_string(),` with `name: input.identity.native_name(&edge.to, eco).map(str::to_string).unwrap_or_else(|| edge.to.name().to_string()),` -- reusing the `eco` binding already computed two lines above in the same block (`let eco = edge.from.ecosystem().unwrap_or_else(|| { ... });`, itself the dependent (`edge.from`) manifest's own ecosystem, falling back to a Cargo.toml/npm filename heuristic when `edge.from` is a PackageId::Bare with no ecosystem tag). `native_name(&self, id: &PackageId, eco: Ecosystem) -> Option<&str>` (crates/callisto-graph/src/identity.rs:493) looks up the name registered for `edge.to` (the rewrite target's PackageId) specifically under `eco` (the dependent's ecosystem) -- the ecosystem-native name as it would appear as a dependency key in a manifest of that ecosystem. When no such registration exists (the common, non-dual-identity case -- no cross-ecosystem identity link was ever established for this target/ecosystem pairing), `native_name` returns `None` and `unwrap_or_else` falls back to `edge.to.name().to_string()`, byte-for-byte identical to today's unconditional expression. Nothing else in the `RewriteKey` construction (`target`, `kind`) or the surrounding `if d.rewrite` block changes.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given a workspace where IdentityIndex.native registers a dual-identity package D under two different native names for two different ecosystems (e.g. (Cargo, "my-native-lib") -> D and (Npm, "@scope/my-native-lib") -> D), and a dependent package Dep whose manifest is in the ecosystem OTHER than D's Cargo-native registration (i.e. Dep's manifest ecosystem is Npm) declares an out-of-range dependency spec on D that solve_cascade decides to rewrite (Coverage::DoesNotCover), the RewriteKey produced in CascadeOutcome.rewrites has name == "@scope/my-native-lib" (the name registered for D under Npm, Dep's own manifest ecosystem) -- not "my-native-lib" (D's PackageId::name()).

AC-001's scenario is exercised through the real, live call path crate::cascade::run_cascade (which calls solve_cascade internally) -- not solely through a direct, isolated call to IdentityIndex::native_name -- confirming the corrected key reaches CascadeOutcome.rewrites via the full cascade fixpoint loop, including the worklist/dependents-of-edge traversal that reaches the rewrite site.

Given a rewrite target package T for which IdentityIndex::native_name(&T, dependent_manifest_ecosystem) returns None (no cross-ecosystem identity registration exists for that specific (T, ecosystem) pairing -- the common, non-dual-identity case covering every package in this repo's existing cascade/rewrite test fixtures), the resulting RewriteKey.name equals T.name() (PackageId::name()) exactly as it did before this fix.

Given the full existing cascade/rewrite test suite (crates/callisto-graph/tests/cascade_tests.rs and crates/callisto-graph/src/cascade.rs's own test module) exercised against workspaces with no dual-identity package anywhere in the workspace, every test's asserted RewriteKey, SpecRewrite, and resulting manifest write is byte-for-byte identical to its pre-fix value -- confirmed by running the existing suite unmodified except for the mechanical addition of the new `identity` field to (a) each CascadeInput struct literal (populated as `&IdentityIndex::default()` for these non-dual-identity fixtures) and (b) each of the 18 hand-constructed Workspace struct literals outside Workspace::load enumerated in `scope` (populated as `IdentityIndex::default()`) -- both are required for the crate to compile at all, per AC-005 -- with zero assertion changes and zero test failures.

CascadeInput gains a required `identity: &'a IdentityIndex` field. Workspace<'a, R, D> gains an actual new `identity: IdentityIndex` field (IdentityIndex derives Clone, so this is an owned field, no new lifetime bound on Workspace), populated ONLY inside the existing non-generic-over-D impl block (`impl<'a, R: CommandRunner> Workspace<'a, R, ManifestWalkResolver>`), the same place Workspace::load already computes `graph.identity()` today for GroupTable::resolve and promoted_siblings -- this is required, not optional: plan_version<R, D, I> and plan_snapshot<R, D> are both generic over D: DependencyResolver, and ManifestWalkResolver::identity() is an inherent method absent from the DependencyResolver trait bound, so `ws.graph.identity()` does not compile inside either generic function body regardless of what D is instantiated with at any real call site -- only a plain struct-field read (`&ws.identity`, no bound on D) compiles unconditionally. Both real construction sites -- plan_version in crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/version.rs and plan_snapshot in crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/snapshot.rs -- are updated to supply `identity: &ws.identity`. The crate fails to compile (a testable, observable proposition: `cargo build -p callisto-graph` and `cargo test -p callisto-graph --no-run`) if either site omits the field or if Workspace lacks the field.

The end-to-end scenario named in the originating bug report -- a real, on-disk Cargo+npm co-located dual-identity package with a cross-ecosystem dependent whose spec needs rewriting -- proceeds through apply_version_plan (not solve_cascade in isolation) to a successful completion: no Err(ManifestError::DependencyNotFound) is returned, and the dependent's manifest on disk is mutated to contain the corrected, ecosystem-native dependency key with the new version spec written under that key. Before this fix, the identical scenario is confirmed (by direct reproduction) to abort apply_version_plan with Err(ManifestError::DependencyNotFound) for the affected package.

Given a rewrite target PackageId::Bare("foo".to_string()) with no IdentityIndex.native registration under the dependent's ecosystem, input.identity.native_name(&edge.to, eco) returns None and the constructed RewriteKey.name equals "foo" (edge.to.name()) -- exercised through the same crate::cascade::run_cascade call path as AC-002, confirming the Bare variant is handled identically to the Prefixed None-registration case in AC-003.

reasoning: Verified all load-bearing claims against live code before drafting: RewriteKey construction at cascade.rs (the `if d.rewrite` block, `name: edge.to.name().to_string()`) confirmed present and unchanged; the `eco` binding used for rewrite_spec's ecosystem argument is computed two lines above the RewriteKey construction and is exactly the dependent (edge.from) manifest's own ecosystem -- the correct second argument for native_name per the requirement's own reasoning. IdentityIndex::native_name(&self, id: &PackageId, eco: Ecosystem) -> Option<&str> confirmed at identity.rs:493, derives Clone confirmed on IdentityIndex at line 338. CascadeInput confirmed to currently have 9 fields (graph, groups, cfg, seed, reasons, named_by, base, pre, tags) with tags added by Track 1 as precedent -- reused that exact struct-field-threading pattern. Both real CascadeInput construction sites confirmed at version.rs:73 and snapshot.rs:54. Workspace::load confirmed defined only in the non-generic-over-D impl block (`impl<'a, R: CommandRunner> Workspace<'a, R, ManifestWalkResolver>`), and `graph.identity()` confirmed already called there today for GroupTable::resolve and promoted_siblings -- so no trait-bound change is needed, matching the requirement's claim. One correction was attempted during drafting -- using ws.graph.identity() directly instead of adding a new Workspace.identity field, reasoning that ManifestWalkResolver::identity() plus Workspace::load's existing non-generic call to it would make a new field redundant. A subsequent audit pass caught that this reasoning, while correct for Workspace::load itself (confirmed non-generic over D), does not extend to plan_version/plan_snapshot, which ARE generic over D and therefore cannot call an inherent ManifestWalkResolver method inside their own generic bodies -- this would not compile. The spec now reverts to the requirement's original design (a genuine new Workspace.identity: IdentityIndex field, populated once at Workspace::load time, read as a plain struct field with no D bound at both real CascadeInput construction sites), which is both requirement-grounded and the only version confirmed to actually compile.
